item.description:
Fixes for Zscaler behavior found in live testing (thanks to the ZTP Policy Wizard project's v2.0 findings).
### Fixed - **Cloud App Control caution rules** now name the browsers they apply to; ZIA refuses a caution action otherwise. - **AI apps** get a caution page, but uploads aren't blocked across the whole category in Balanced, Permissive and ZTH Ebook any more, because ZIA doesn't accept that combination. Blocking uploads to specific AI apps comes in 1.1. - **Balanced social media** blocks posting with viewing allowed, the combination ZIA accepts. Balanced's file-sharing, webmail, chat-file and streaming-upload blocks allow viewing alongside the block. If ZIA refuses one of them across a whole category, Apply leaves it out with an explanation instead of failing. - **ZIA sign-in:** when ZIA ends its API session before the sign-in expires, the app signs in again and carries on. - **Timeouts:** a read or a settings change that times out is tried once more. - **DLP engines:** their descriptions are kept within ZIA's 255-byte limit.
